title: MCP Servers and Tools in C#
description: Implement MCP servers, tools, resources, and prompts in C# with production-ready patterns.
longDescription: Move from MCP concepts to working code. This module shows how to build MCP servers in C#, register tools and resources, validate inputs, handle errors, secure access, and connect MCP clients from .NET applications.
whatYouLearn: Create an MCP server project in C#
Define tools with typed inputs and rich descriptions
Serve resources and prompts over HTTP and stdio
Add validation, logging, and structured error responses
Secure MCP endpoints and deploy them for production use
